title: Let authors push their own candidates to test refs for remote runners (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, coder skill)
outcome: A coder can hand a remote runner its candidate by pushing it to its own test ref, instead of sending mailbox parts, under instruction text both coordinators agreed and Greg approved.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md carry the same 'Author test refs' wording, and the coder test-execution skill tells coders to use it for remote runs, in the exact wording both coordinators concurred on.
Greg was sent the final wording and its consequence before the landing, and his word on the widening is quoted verbatim with its source; no objection from him is recorded.
The final-diff audit by the other project's coordinator passed on the landed input, and the change landed under the standing rule.

completion.summary: Author test-ref authority text and matching coder skill landed unchanged in combo29c, with exact concurrence, Greg notice and widening word, final-input audit PASS, fresh composite review pair and eligible same-tree FULL.
